newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a strong buy.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said in a report it has maintained its strong buy rating and year-end target price of $135 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) for Brazilian federal telecoms giant Telebras.
-- The brokerage cited Telebras's unaudited two-month results, released last week, as well as a recently announced rate rebalancing that "will begin making a net positive impact around mid-1997."
-- "We believe year-to-date abbreviated numbers suggest ... that Telebras is on course to meet our $9.70 per ADS full-year 1997 earnings forecast," the report said.
-- Bear Stearns said the company posted earnings of $1.50 per ADS in the two-month period, which taken on a quarterly basis "translates to $2.25 per ADS, 20 percent above our $1.87 estimate for Q1."
-- Telebras ADRs were off 7/8 at 110 on the New York Stock Exchange. Its preferred shares were up 0.34 percent at 117.10 reais on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
